zh: 加油站
道路旁的搜刮点，也能寻找废弃汽车。
回收机可拆解可回收物；原始资源不能放入，输出格满时机器会停下。
木箱可得废料及随机资源、饮水、工具、护甲和组件；附近可能找到可修复汽车。
回收机有声音，附近玩家可能听到；汽车没有归属，别人也能开走。
en: Gas station
A roadside stop for loot and abandoned cars.
Use the recycler for recyclable items. Raw resources cannot go in, and a full output stops the machine.
Wooden crates can yield Scrap and varied supplies; a repairable car may be nearby.
The recycler is audible, and any player can drive an unclaimed car.

zh: 停车场
可以找车，也可以回收物资的地点。
给汽车装上电池、发动机并加入燃料瓶才能驾驶；停车场还有回收机，可处理可回收物。
不同汽车可载一人或多人，乘客能在行驶中射击；部分汽车有 25 格后备箱。
汽车没有归属，后备箱也不上锁；使用回收机时也要留意周围玩家。
en: Parking lot
A place to find cars and recycle items.
Install a battery and an engine, then add Fuel Bottles. A recycler is also available here.
Cars have different seating capacities; some carry an unlocked 25-slot boot.
Cars have no owner. Watch for other players while using the recycler.
source_note: 停车场回收机：玩家实战反馈，2026-10-23。

zh: 城镇
有木箱与回收机的物资探索区。
搜查建筑周围的木箱，再用回收机把可回收物拆成制作资源。
木箱可出废料、饮水、布料、防辐射药、工具、护甲和组件，具体内容随机。
物资点会吸引其他玩家；回收机运转声会暴露位置。
en: Town
An area with wooden crates and a recycler.
Search crates, then recycle suitable items into crafting resources.
Crates can contain Scrap, water, tools, armour and components; contents vary.
Other players may search the same area, and the recycler makes noise.

zh: 仓库
箱子密集、容易遇到其他玩家的搜刮点。
官方列出 5 个普通箱、8 个油桶、2 个红色工具箱、1 个军用箱和 2 个随机箱的刷新点，并设有回收机。
油桶偏废料与组件，工具箱偏工具材料；军用箱的废料通常比普通箱多。刷新点不代表每次都有物资。
官方提醒此处玩家遭遇率高，独行时先想好撤离方向。
en: Warehouse
A dense loot site where encounters with other players are common.
The official layout lists 5 regular crate points, 8 barrels, 2 red toolboxes, 1 military box, 2 random box points and a recycler.
Barrels yield Scrap and components; toolboxes favour tool materials. Spawn points are not guaranteed loot.
Plan an exit before searching, especially when alone.

zh: 废弃工厂与幸运转盘
转盘所在区域有安全区，也是寻找瓶盖商人的线索点。
可用废料在幸运转盘下注；安全区内玩家互伤关闭，界面会显示安全区提示。
押中可得废料；玩家报告花瓶盖的商人在转盘所在建筑的左侧。
押错会损失废料；安全区只覆盖转盘周围，离开边界后仍有玩家风险。
en: Abandoned factory and Lucky Wheel
The wheel area has a safe zone and a reported Caps trader nearby.
Bet Scrap at the Lucky Wheel. PvP damage is disabled inside the marked safe zone.
A winning bet pays Scrap; a player reported a Caps trader left of the wheel.
A losing bet costs Scrap. PvP danger returns outside the safe-zone boundary.

zh: 伐木工人
有安全区和回收机的资源交易点。
伐木工人现在交换资源，不再发旧版伐木任务；进入安全区时看界面提示。
适合把采到的资源交换成所需物资，并就地回收可回收物。
安全区外仍可发生玩家对抗，回收机运行时也会发出声音。
en: Lumberjack trader
A resource trader with a safe zone and recycler.
The Lumberjack exchanges resources rather than issuing the old gathering quests.
Trade gathered materials and recycle suitable items nearby.
PvP danger resumes beyond the safe zone, and the recycler is audible.

zh: 矿工
有安全区和回收机的资源交易点。
矿工现在交换资源；官方还在陨石钻机区域增加了第二位石匠商人。
适合将采集物就地交换，或使用附近回收机处理可回收物。
交易时留意安全区提示，离开边界后仍需防备其他玩家。
en: Miner trader
A resource trading point with a safe zone and recycler.
The trader exchanges resources. A second Stonecutter was added near the meteorite drill.
Trade gathered materials or recycle suitable items nearby.
Watch the safe-zone indicator; PvP danger returns beyond its boundary.

zh: 工厂
工业探索地点，以特殊金属箱为主要玩法。
寻找并开启工厂内的特殊金属箱；官方介绍强调这里有多条探索路线。
金属箱提供贵重战利品；具体内容随箱子和刷新而变化。
路线较多，搜箱时留意周围玩家，不要把这里当作安全区。
en: Factory
An industrial site centred on special metal loot boxes.
Find and open the special metal boxes; the official update describes several routes through the area.
The boxes offer valuable loot, with contents varying by spawn.
Watch for other players while searching the routes; this is not a marked safe zone.

zh: 陨石钻机点
围绕钻机与三组拉杆展开的资源地点。
在三个房间启动拉杆，相邻启动间隔不能超过 10 秒；故障时看灯光提示，并在 30 秒内修复。
钻机成功运转 3 分钟，产出高品质金属和石头，随后冷却 15 分钟；附近还有资源商人。
操作期间需反复移动并停留，注意其他玩家和地点内的异常危险。
en: Meteorite drill
A resource site built around a drill and three lever rooms.
Start all three levers within 10-second intervals. Use room lights to find failures and repair a lever within 30 seconds.
The drill runs for 3 minutes, producing HQM and stone, then cools down for 15 minutes; traders are nearby.
The sequence keeps you on site, so watch for other players and environmental hazards.

zh: 军事基地
有武装守卫、防空炮和雷达空投机制的高风险地点。
新版流程需启动室内三台电脑取得门禁卡，再到中央雷达屋顶使用；官方帮助页还记载守卫有机会掉卡。
雷达会呼叫多箱空投，使用后进入冷却；门禁卡会消耗。
守卫会投掷手雷并成组进攻，防空炮攻击直升机；空投还会通知附近玩家。
en: Military base
A high-risk site with armed guards, anti-air defenses and radar airdrops.
The newer route activates three indoor computers for a keycard; official support also records a chance to loot one from guards.
Use the card at the radar roof to call multiple airdrops. The card is consumed and the radar enters cooldown.
Guards throw grenades and attack in groups; nearby players are notified when drops arrive.

zh: 飞机坠毁点
可搜索贵重物资与舰长钥匙卡的废弃飞机。
先搜机头：玩家提供的实战线索是在那里找到舰长钥匙卡；机头是找卡的位置。
飞机有贵重战利品，舰长卡不能制造；拿到后再寻找其他读卡器。
游戏内说明指出卡不能用于驾驶舱；卡片不保证每次搜查都出现，周围也可能有其他玩家。
en: Plane crash
A crashed aircraft with valuable loot and a Captain Keycard.
Search the nose first: a player reported finding the card there. The nose is a pickup area.
The plane holds valuable loot; the card cannot be crafted. Look for another reader after finding it.
The card does not work in the cockpit and is not guaranteed on every search. Watch for other players.

zh: 灯塔
水域中的攀爬探索点，有隐藏矿洞和高等级战利品。
官方公布的玩法是三处拉杆、进入隐藏矿洞、收集物资并在限时内撤离。
可获得高等级战利品；探索时要同时留意攀爬路线与返回路线。
限时撤离与攀爬带来风险，携带贵重物资离开时还需防备玩家。
en: Lighthouse
An offshore climbing site with a hidden mine and high-tier loot.
The official route involves three levers, a hidden mine, collecting loot and escaping against a timer.
High-tier loot rewards careful exploration and a planned return route.
Climbing and timed escape are hazards; other players may contest the exit.

zh: 核电站
需要考虑辐射防护的探索地点。
进入前检查防护装备与辐射提示；官方把带辐射防护的军用护甲列为适合核电站行动的装备。
辐射区可寻找军用箱，这类箱子的废料通常比普通箱多。
辐射会持续威胁生命，具体箱位与内容并非固定承诺。
en: Nuclear power plant
A location where radiation protection matters.
Check your protection and radiation indicator before entering. Official updates recommend radiation-resistant military armour for plant runs.
Look for military boxes in radiation zones; they usually contain more Scrap than ordinary crates.
Radiation is a continuing hazard, and no specific box or item is guaranteed.

zh: 火车站
大型铁路地点，官方定位为贵重物资争夺区。
可沿铁路寻找列车；列车需要燃料瓶，任何玩家都能驾驶，机车与车厢货舱均不上锁。
站区有贵重战利品；遇到列车时可检查货舱，但列车不固定在车站刷新。
官方提醒这里容易交火；行驶列车会撞伤轨道上的玩家，铁轨附近不能建造。
en: Railway station
A large railway site known for contested valuable loot.
Search the tracks for trains. Anyone can drive one with Fuel Bottles, and both cargo holds are unlocked.
The station has valuable loot; train cargo is worth checking, but trains do not spawn at a fixed station point.
Expect player fights. Moving trains can hurt people on the tracks, where building is forbidden.

zh: 电力线塔
可通过电线滑行的高处通行点。
攀上塔的平台搜查箱子与油桶，再沿连接塔间的电线移动。
平台容器提供物资；滑索可跨越森林和山丘。
滑行时暴露在空中，地面玩家容易看到；这不是可建造的瞭望塔。
en: Power-line tower
An elevated travel point linked to other towers by wires.
Search crates and barrels on the platform, then ride the wire like a zipline.
Platform containers hold loot, and the line crosses forests and hills.
You are exposed and easy to spot while riding; this is not a player-built watchtower.
